text: “Good-ness gracious!” she says, “what in the world can have become of him?” “I can’t imagine,” says the old gentleman; “and I must say it makes me dreadful uneasy.” “Uneasy!” she says; “I’m ready to go distracted! He must a come; and you’ve missed him along the road. I know it’s so—something tells me so.” “Why, Sally, I couldn’t miss him along the road—you know that.” “But oh, dear, dear, what will Sis say! He must a come! You must a missed him.
